annotation.title_clean: Building a responsible AI: How to manage the AI ethics debate
annotation.title_en: Building a responsible AI: How to manage the AI ethics debate
annotation.summary_en: ISO explainer on responsible AI and AI ethics. It lists key principles (fairness, transparency, non-maleficence, accountability, privacy, robustness, inclusiveness) and advises organisations on ethics policies, oversight committees, data practices and testing. It gives corporate examples and says standards and regulations are needed. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Responsible AI aims to benefit society while minimising negative consequences such as bias and privacy harms.
Seven principles: fairness, transparency, non-maleficence, accountability, privacy, robustness, inclusiveness.
Organisations should set up ethics committees or review boards and embed ethics in design.
A robust ecosystem of standards and regulations is needed for responsible AI.
Good practice: diverse data, multiple metrics, continual testing for bias.
